content.totp.heading: Authenticator app
content.totp.description: Review the authenticator method available for your account.
content.totp.status.label: AUTHENTICATOR APP
content.totp.status.activeDescription: Codes from this method can be used when Tunner asks you to confirm it’s you.
content.totp.status.inactiveDescription: Set up a compatible authenticator app to create verification codes.
content.totp.status.unavailableDescription: Your current authenticator information could not be loaded.
content.totp.manage.heading: Your authenticator
content.totp.manage.description: Use your compatible authenticator app to generate the current code when requested.
content.totp.manage.guidanceDescription: Review the available options before changing this method.
content.totp.manage.guidanceEffects: Tunner will show the effects of the change before you continue.
content.totp.methods.label: Authenticator app
content.totp.methods.description: Use time-based verification codes when requested.
content.totp.methods.inactiveDescription: Start setup and verify the first code before this method becomes active.
content.totp.methods.unavailable: Authenticator setup is not available right now. Please try again later.
content.totp.setup.heading: Set up an authenticator app
content.totp.setup.description: Scan the QR code with a compatible authenticator app.
content.totp.setup.scanDescription: Open your authenticator app, choose to add an account, then scan this code.
content.totp.setup.manualDescription: Enter the setup key manually in your authenticator app.
content.totp.setup.warning: Never share your setup key or verification codes.
content.totp.setup.codeDescription: Enter the current code shown in your authenticator app to finish setup.
content.totp.setup.consumedHeading: Finish setting up your authenticator app
content.totp.setup.consumedDescription: Enter the current code from the app you already added.
content.totp.setup.alreadyShownDescription: The QR code and setup key are no longer displayed. Enter the current code from the app you added to complete this setup.
content.totp.setup.guidanceDescription: Authenticator apps can generate codes while your device is offline.
content.totp.setup.preparingDescription: Please wait while the current request is checked.
content.totp.setup.verifyingDescription: Please wait before submitting another code.
content.totp.setup.expiredDescription: Return to review setup before starting a new request.
content.totp.setup.unknownDescription: Check the status of the original request before trying again.
content.totp.setup.codeUnavailable: Code entry is unavailable while this request is checked.
content.totp.setup.qrUnavailable: The QR code could not be displayed. Use the setup key.
content.totp.ready.heading: Authenticator app is ready
content.totp.ready.description: Codes from this method can be used when Tunner requests verification.
content.totp.disable.heading: Remove authenticator app?
content.totp.disable.description: Codes from this authenticator will no longer be accepted after removal.
content.totp.disable.preserve: This action keeps existing Tunner sessions active.
content.totp.disable.affectedSessions: Affected Tunner sessions will end. Your current session remains active.
content.totp.disable.currentSessionEnds: Your current Tunner session will end. You will need to sign in again.
content.totp.disable.confirmDescription: Review this action and its effects before continuing.
content.totp.reset.heading: Review authenticator replacement
content.totp.reset.description: Review the effect on this authenticator before continuing.
content.totp.reset.separateEnrollment: This reset removes the selected authenticator. Review a separate setup after the reset is confirmed.
content.totp.reset.preserve: This action keeps existing Tunner sessions active.
content.totp.reset.affectedSessions: Affected Tunner sessions will end. Your current session remains active.
content.totp.reset.currentSessionEnds: Your current Tunner session will end. You will need to sign in again.
content.totp.terminal.preserveDescription: Your current Tunner session remains active.
content.totp.terminal.endedDescription: The original result is confirmed. Sign in again to continue.
content.totp.terminal.resetDescription: The previous authenticator can no longer be used. Review a new setup separately.
content.totp.terminal.unknown: The original result is not confirmed. Check its status before trying again.
content.totp.code.label: Verification code
content.totp.error.code: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
content.totp.error.credentials: The code could not be verified. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
content.totp.error.replayed: This code has already been used. Wait for the next code in your authenticator app.
content.totp.error.limited: Verification is temporarily limited. Please try again later.
content.totp.error.changed: This request has changed or expired. Return to review the action.
content.totp.error.unavailable: This request could not be completed. Check its status before trying again.
content.totp.error.eligibility: This action is not available for the selected authenticator.
content.totp.error.limit: Another authenticator cannot be added right now.
content.totp.error.qr: The QR code could not be displayed. Use the setup key.
content.totp.error.policy: Verification is not available right now. Check the original request before trying again.
content.totp.mfa.heading: Confirm it’s you
content.totp.mfa.description: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
content.totp.mfa.pending: Checking your code. Please wait before submitting again.
content.totp.mfa.unknown: We are checking this sign-in request. Please wait before trying again.
content.totp.mfa.expiredDescription: Return to sign in before trying again.
content.totp.mfa.unavailable: No authenticator is currently available for this sign-in request.
content.totp.selection.heading: Choose an authenticator app
content.totp.selection.proofDescription: Choose the app you want to use for this verification.
content.totp.selection.loginDescription: Choose the app you want to use to finish signing in.
content.totp.selection.numberExplanation: Numbers identify these options. They are not names in your authenticator app.
content.totp.selection.selectedDescription: Enter the current code from the app you chose.

step_up_content.stepUp.totp.description: Enter the current code from your authenticator app for this action.
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.code.label: Verification code
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.pending: Checking your code. Please wait before submitting again.
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.unknown: We are checking this verification. Please wait before trying again.
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.expired: This verification can no longer be used. Return to review the action.
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.error.code: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.error.credentials: The code could not be verified. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
step_up_content.stepUp.totp.error.replayed: This code has already been used. Wait for the next code in your authenticator app.
